answer: In an agent economy, access to paid jobs is proportional to tokens locked for 30 days, with each agent's stake recorded in the job thread. An orchard planner and a sparrow tracker follow the same rule: splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities earns no more total allocation than staking them under one. To gain more access, an attacker must lock more capital, forgoing its use elsewhere and bearing its price risk for the full month.
